verifyNote: Mayor Tarrow is a named villain (Rules_Scope §1) but has no stat block in the docs yet; add one in M8.

foes.name: Grey Company bruiser
foes.summary: Bandit stats fighting with fists and clubs; the brawl is nonlethal, so heroes knock them out.

foes.name: Grisk Two-Teeth
foes.summary: The goblin warren's chief. Uses hobgoblin stats because "goblin boss" isn't in the SRD.
foes.art: Chipped chainmail, gold-capped tusks, pot-lid shield

foes.name: Brother Ulric
foes.summary: The cult's foreman-priest. Falls unconscious at 0 HP so the story can continue.
foes.art: Broad, grey-bearded foreman; lantern hook in place of a hand

foes.name: Scald
foes.summary: A wyrmling from Cindrath's ancient clutch, hatched by the mountain's heat. Deadly at L2, Hard at L3.
foes.art: Dog-sized, eggshell still stuck to one horn, hoarding copper pots

foes.name: Sister Venna
foes.art: Widow's veil burned at the edges, ember-red prayer beads

foes.name: Mother Sallow
foes.summary: The marsh hag; her bargain can be struck instead of fought.

foes.name: The Drowned Abbot
foes.summary: The abbey's last abbot, who refused to leave his flooded crypt. Deadly at L4, Hard at L5. The party chooses one reward.
foes.art: A drowned abbot in a waterlogged sun-vestment

foes.name: Ser Ida Marrow
foes.summary: King Varrow's honor guard, still keeping her oath.
foes.art: A tall, armored woman with frost in her eye sockets and a broken crown-sigil on her shield

foes.name: Vorrag the Kiln-Smith
foes.summary: A fire giant who wants the crown for his forge. Can be talked into a duel or a smithing contest. Deadly at L5, Hard at L6.

foes.name: Maelis Varrow
foes.summary: The archivist who would wake Cindrath. Falls unconscious at 0 HP so the endings can play out.
foes.art: Archivist's coat, ink-stained fingers, a hooded lantern whose flame is the wrong color

foes.name: Cindrath's ember-wraith
foes.summary: The finale's second phase. Weakens as the crown shards are struck.
